Plan and build nurture streams, manage one-off emails, and build/maintain landing pages for events, webinars, email sequences, etc.
Handle form creation and field mapping, and coordinate with the team to sync with Salesforce CRM systems – form creation and management includes integrations with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
Deploy and maintain Marketo Munchkin code on websites to track visitor behavior and support lead generation and scoring mechanisms.
Design and use Marketo Custom Objects to store and manipulate unique business data, using them to enrich segments, smart lists, and campaigns.
Configure and execute Smart Campaigns in Marketo, leveraging their dynamic capabilities for targeted and responsive marketing efforts.
Use Marketo Flow Actions to automate complex marketing processes, supporting campaign execution and operational efficiency.
Support the generation and implementation of test strategies, including A/B testing to improve qualified traffic and conversion-related activities.
Monitor, analyze, and report on program performance.
Map and build automation to support multi-channel attribution.
Develop and monitor lead grading and scoring model strategies to optimize the lead funnel.
Maintain data hygiene, list development, prospect segmentation, form management, and data model governance.
Build and test responsive email templates that meet quality standards and email best practices.
Execute marketing best practices, including configuration and maintenance of campaign and nurture workflows, program builds, and associated reporting metrics.
Assist with technical feasibility, implementation approach, deployment strategies, and QA effort.
cond_0115.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
Experience with Marketo, including Smart Campaigns, Flow Actions, Custom Objects, and Munchkin code.
Experience with Salesforce CRM and form field mapping.
Ability to translate complex data integration requirements into clear next steps for the team.
Strong project management experience.
Able to work independently and within a team.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with Adobe CDP, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), or similar platforms.
Experience with data integration and ERP systems.
Critical thinking and ability to connect business needs to technical roadmaps and solutions.
Solutions-oriented approach that supports coordination across multiple teams.
Aptitude for technical challenges combined with business acumen.

Deploy and maintain Marketo Munchkin code on websites to track visitor behavior and support lead generation and scoring mechanisms.

Develop and monitor lead grading and scoring model strategies to optimize the lead funnel.
Maintain data hygiene, list development, prospect segmentation, form management, and data model governance.

Execute marketing best practices, including configuration and maintenance of campaign and nurture workflows, program builds, and associated reporting metrics.
